books.title: 100 Haiku
books.blurb: A compact collection of haiku that carries the hush of yearning, the brightness of small joys, and the tenderness of fleeting moments.

books.title: Beyond 24
books.blurb: This book looks beyond the surface of routine life and asks what remains when the clock stops being the measure of your meaning.

books.title: I 4 You
books.blurb: A tender and emotionally raw work about affection, relationship, and the ways love changes the language of a human heart.

books.title: I Fell in Love with a Geek
books.blurb: A story about falling for the person who is both deeply ordinary and strangely unforgettable, where intelligence, awkwardness, and tenderness collide.

books.title: I Fell in Love with an Asshole
books.blurb: A brutally honest account of desire, attachment, and the confusion that comes when emotion meets disappointment and self-deception.

books.title: Poem Shop
books.blurb: A poetic catalogue of memory, longing, observation, and the strange beauty of everyday life turned into language.

books.title: Run: The Secret Destination
books.blurb: A reflective journey of motion, self-discovery, and the hidden destination that emerges when the body keeps moving and the soul starts listening.

books.title: The Void
books.blurb: An intimate meditation on absence, emptiness, and the quiet courage it takes to sit with what cannot be filled by words alone.
